# PIK Connect

> PIK Connect is the client photo-gallery and photo-delivery platform of PK Photography, a wedding, event and commercial photography studio based in Mumbai and Goa, India. Event guests take a selfie and instantly receive every photo of themselves from the event gallery using face recognition.

## About
- Studio: PK Photography — founder Prabhakar Kumar. 12+ years of experience, rated 4.9 stars across 380+ Google reviews, 98% repeat/referral clients.
- What PIK Connect does: guests find their event photos in seconds by taking a selfie; clients view, download and share private, secure galleries; studios manage events, clients and album flipbooks.
- Service areas: Mumbai (Andheri West) and Goa (Morjim), plus destination and pan-India coverage.

## Services
Wedding photography & videography, pre-wedding & destination weddings (Goa), event & corporate photography, portraits & headshots, editorial & portfolio, product & fashion, drone / aerial photography, live streaming, family & kids photography.
